## Why it matters

Europeana serves as a multilingual discovery platform for cultural heritage collections from European libraries, archives, and museums.

Its broad coverage makes it useful for cross-border source discovery when your research needs books, images, newspapers, manuscripts, or other primary materials in one search environment.
